acquisition method: Protein quantification was performed using Vanquish UHPLC (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and TSQ-Vantage EMR (Thermo Fisher Scientific) with a HESI-II ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific) in multiple reaction monitoring (MRM) mode.
alkylation reagent: Ten microliters of supernatant was reduced by dithiothreitol, alkylated with iodoacetamide, and digested with trypsin/Lys-C mix (Promega) in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (pH 8.0) (Sigma) at 37 °C overnight.
cleavage agent: Ten microliters of supernatant was reduced by dithiothreitol, alkylated with iodoacetamide, and digested with trypsin/Lys-C mix (Promega) in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (pH 8.0) (Sigma) at 37 °C overnight.
collision energy: The respective optimum MS parameters for each analyte were as follows: declustering potential of 76 and 81 V, collision energies of 41 and 31 V, and collision cell exit potential of 12 and 14 V for RK-701 and IS, respectively.
instrument: The trypsinized sample was applied to an EASY-nLC 1000 liquid chromatograph (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a nanospray ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific). Protein quantification was performed using Vanquish UHPLC (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and TSQ-Vantage EMR (Thermo Fisher Scientific) with a HESI-II ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific) in multiple reaction monitoring (MRM) mode.
ionization type: Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a nanospray ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific). labeling: For protein quantification analysis by LC–MS/MS, 10 pmol of stable isotope–labeled peptides (synthesized by the Support Unit for Bio-Material Analysis, RIKEN Center for Brain Science) were added to the digested sample as an internal standard.
